explication: Codex CLI is a local coding agent. Its user-facing workflow begins at the CLI, establishes identity and configuration, manages a coding thread, and uses model/tool integrations to act on the local workspace. The tree and excerpts also show MCP server/tool handling and plugin support as significant capabilities. Several runtime paths are unsampled, so uncertain connections are omitted; dashed links mark only broad workflow relationships documented by the README.
